name: Chart
description: Represents a chart in a presentation.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: ChartType
properties.description: Returns or sets the chart type. Read/write XlChartType.

properties.name: HasDataTable
properties.description: True if the chart has a data table. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PlotBy
properties.description: Returns or sets the way columns or rows are used as data series on the chart. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DataTable
properties.description: Returns the chart data table. Read-only DataTable.

properties.name: BarShape
properties.description: Returns or sets the shape used for every series in a 3D bar or column chart. Read/write XlBarShape.

properties.name: SideWall
properties.description: Returns a Walls object that allows the user to individually format the side wall of a 3D chart. Read-only.

properties.name: BackWall
properties.description: Returns an object that allows the user to individually format the back wall of a 3D chart. Read-only Walls.

properties.name: ChartStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the chart style for the chart. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether to show the data labels when the value is greater than the maximum value on the value axis. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ChartData
properties.description: Returns information about the linked or embedded data associated with a chart. Read-only ChartData.

properties.name: Shapes
properties.description: Returns a collection that represents all the shapes on the chart sheet. Read-only Shapes.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft PowerPoint application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: AutoScaling
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word scales a 3D chart so that it is closer in size to the equivalent 2D chart. The RightAngleAxes property must be True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ChartArea
properties.description: Returns the complete chart area for the chart. Read-only ChartArea.

properties.name: ChartTitle
properties.description: Returns the title of the specified chart. Read-only ChartTitle.

properties.name: DepthPercent
properties.description: Returns or sets the depth of a 3D chart as a percentage of the chart width (between 20 and 2000 percent). Read/write Long.

properties.name: DisplayBlanksAs
properties.description: Returns or sets the way that blank cells are plotted on a chart. Can be one of the XlDisplayBlanksAs constants. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Elevation
properties.description: Returns or sets the elevation, in degrees, of the 3D chart view. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Floor
properties.description: Returns the floor of the 3D chart. Read-only Floor.

properties.name: GapDepth
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance, as a percentage of the marker width, between the data series in a 3D chart. Read/write Long.

properties.name: HasAxis
properties.description: Returns or sets which axes exist on the chart. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: HasLegend
properties.description: True if the chart has a legend. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasTitle
properties.description: True if the axis or chart has a visible title. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HeightPercent
properties.description: Returns or sets the height of a 3D chart as a percentage of the chart width (from 5 through 500 percent). Read/write Long.

properties.name: Legend
properties.description: Returns the legend for the chart. Read-only Legend.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Read/write

properties.name: Perspective
properties.description: Returns or sets the perspective for the 3D chart view. Read/write Long.

properties.name: PlotArea
properties.description: Returns the plot area of a chart. Read-only PlotArea.

properties.name: PlotVisibleOnly
properties.description: True if only visible cells are plotted. False if both visible and hidden cells are plotted. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RightAngleAxes
properties.description: True if the chart axes are at right angles, independent of chart rotation or elevation. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Rotation
properties.description: Returns or sets the rotation, in degrees, of the 3D chart view (the rotation of the plot area around the z-axis). Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Walls
properties.description: Returns the walls of the 3D chart. Read-only Walls.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns the ChartFormat object. Read-only.

properties.name: ShowReportFilterFieldButtons
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether to display the report filter field buttons on a PivotChart. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowLegendFieldButtons
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether to display legend field buttons on a PivotChart. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowAxisFieldButtons
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether to display axis field buttons on a PivotChart. Read/write

properties.name: ShowValueFieldButtons
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether to display the value field buttons on a PivotChart. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowAllFieldButtons
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether to display all field buttons on a PivotChart. Read/write.

properties.name: AlternativeText
properties.description: Returns or sets the alternative text associated with a shape in a Web presentation. Read/write.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Gets or sets a String that represents the title of the chart. Read/write.

properties.name: CategoryLabelLevel
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlCategoryLabel constant that specifies the source level of the chart category labels. Read/write.

properties.name: SeriesNameLevel
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlSeriesNameLevel constant that specifies the source level of the series names. Read/write.

properties.name: ChartColor
properties.description: Returns or sets an integer that represents the color scheme for the chart. Read/write.

methods.name: ApplyDataLabels
methods.signature: ApplyDataLabels([Type As XlDataLabelsType], [LegendKey As Variant], [AutoText As Variant], [HasLeaderLines As Variant], [ShowSeriesName As Variant], [ShowCategoryName As Variant], [ShowValue As Variant], [ShowPercentage As Variant], [ShowBubbleSize As Variant], [Separator As Variant])
methods.description: Applies data labels to all the series in a chart.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: One of the enumeration values that specifies the type of data label to apply. Can be one of the xlDataLabelsType constants.

parameters.name: LegendKey
parameters.description: True to show the legend key next to the point. The default is False.

parameters.name: AutoText
parameters.description: True if the object automatically generates appropriate text based on content.

parameters.name: HasLeaderLines
parameters.description: For the Chart and Series objects, True if the series has leader lines.

parameters.name: ShowSeriesName
parameters.description: True to enable the series name for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: ShowCategoryName
parameters.description: True to enable the category name for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: ShowValue
parameters.description: True to enable the value for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: ShowPercentage
parameters.description: True to enable the percentage for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: ShowBubbleSize
parameters.description: True to enable the bubble size for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: Separator
parameters.description: The separator for the data label.

methods.name: GetChartElement
methods.signature: GetChartElement(X As Long, Y As Long, ElementID As Long, Arg1 As Long, Arg2 As Long)
methods.description: Returns information about the chart element at the specified x-coordinate and y-coordinate.

parameters.name: X
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the chart element.

parameters.name: Y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the chart element.

parameters.name: ElementID
parameters.description: When the method returns, this argument contains the XlChartItem value of the chart element at the specified coordinates. For more information, see the Remarks section.

parameters.name: Arg1
parameters.description: When the method returns, this argument contains information related to the chart element. For more information, see the Remarks section.

parameters.name: Arg2
parameters.description: When the method returns, this argument contains information related to the chart element. For more information, see the Remarks section.

methods.name: SetSourceData
methods.description: Sets the source data range for the chart.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The address of the chart data range that contains the source data.

parameters.name: PlotBy
parameters.description: Specifies the way the data will be plotted. Can be either of the following XlRowCol constants: xlColumns or xlRows.

methods.name: SetBackgroundPicture
methods.description: Sets the background graphic for a chart.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the file for the graphic.

methods.name: Paste
methods.description: Pastes chart data from the Clipboard into the chart.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies the chart information to paste if a chart is on the Clipboard. Can be one of the following values:

methods.name: SetDefaultChart
methods.description: Specifies the name of the chart template that Microsoft Word uses when it creates new charts.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the default chart template that Word uses when it creates new charts. This name can be set to either the name of a user-defined chart template in the gallery or a special XlChartGallery constant, xlBuiltIn, to specify a built-in chart template.

methods.name: ApplyChartTemplate
methods.description: Applies a standard or custom chart type to a chart.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The file name for a chart template.

methods.name: SaveChartTemplate
methods.description: Saves a custom chart template to the list of available chart templates.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the chart template.

methods.name: ClearToMatchStyle
methods.description: Clears the chart elements formatting to automatic.

methods.name: ApplyLayout
methods.description: Applies the layouts shown in the Ribbon.

parameters.name: Layout
parameters.description: The type of layout. The type of layout is denoted by a number from 1 to 10.

parameters.name: ChartType
parameters.description: An XlChartType constant that represents the type of chart.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Causes the specified chart to be redrawn immediately.

methods.name: Axes
methods.signature: Axes([Type As Variant], [AxisGroup As XlAxisGroup]) As Object
methods.description: Returns a collection of axes on the chart.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The axis to return. Can be one of the following XlAxisType constants: xlValue, xlCategory, or xlSeriesAxis (xlSeriesAxis is valid only for 3D charts).

parameters.name: AxisGroup
parameters.description: One of the enumeration values that specifies the axis group. The default is xlPrimary.

methods.name: ChartGroups
methods.description: Returns an object that represents either a single chart group or a collection of all the chart groups in the chart.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The chart group number. If specified, a single ChartGroup object is returned. If omitted, a ChartGroups object is returned which contains a collection of every ChartGroup object for that chart.

methods.name: ChartWizard
methods.signature: ChartWizard([Source As Variant], [Gallery As Variant], [Format As Variant], [PlotBy As Variant], [CategoryLabels As Variant], [SeriesLabels As Variant], [HasLegend As Variant], [Title As Variant], [CategoryTitle As Variant], [ValueTitle As Variant], [ExtraTitle As Variant])
methods.description: Modifies the properties of the given chart. Use this method to quickly format a chart without setting all the individual properties. This method is noninteractive, and it changes only the specified properties.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The range that contains the source data for the new chart. If this argument is omitted, Word edits the active chart sheet or the selected chart on the active worksheet.

parameters.name: Gallery
parameters.description: One of the XlChartType constants that specifies the chart type.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: The option number for the built-in autoformats. Can be a number from 1 through 10, depending on the gallery type. If this argument is omitted, Word chooses a default value based on the gallery type and data source.

parameters.name: PlotBy
parameters.description: Specifies whether the data for each series is in rows or columns. Can be one of the following XlRowCol constants: xlRows or xlColumns.

parameters.name: CategoryLabels
parameters.description: An integer that specifies the number of rows or columns within the source range that contain category labels. Allowed values are from 0 (zero) through one less than the maximum number of the corresponding categories or series.

parameters.name: SeriesLabels
parameters.description: An integer that specifies the number of rows or columns within the source range that contain series labels. Allowed values are from 0 (zero) through one less than the maximum number of the corresponding categories or series.

parameters.name: HasLegend
parameters.description: True to include a legend.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The chart title text.

parameters.name: CategoryTitle
parameters.description: The category axis title text.

parameters.name: ValueTitle
parameters.description: The value axis title text.

parameters.name: ExtraTitle
parameters.description: The series axis title for 3D charts or the second value axis title for 2D charts.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Not supported for this object.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: Not supported for this object.

parameters.name: After
parameters.description: Not supported for this object.

methods.name: CopyPicture
methods.signature: CopyPicture([Appearance As XlPictureAppearance], [Format As XlCopyPictureFormat], [Size As XlPictureAppearance])
methods.description: Copies the selected object to the Clipboard as a picture.

parameters.name: Appearance
parameters.description: One of the enumeration values that specifies how the picture should be copied. The default is xlScreen.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: One of the enumeration values that specifies the format of the picture. The default is xlPicture.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: One of the enumeration values that specifies the size of the copied picture when the object is a chart on a chart sheet (not embedded on a worksheet). The default is xlPrinter.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the object.

methods.name: Export
methods.signature: Export(FileName As String, [FilterName As Variant], [Interactive As Variant]) As Boolean
methods.description: Exports the chart in a graphic format.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the exported file.

parameters.name: FilterName
parameters.description: The language-independent name of the graphic filter as it appears in the registry, for example, PNG or GIF. PNG is the default if no value is supplied.

parameters.name: Interactive
parameters.description: N/A

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Selects the object.

parameters.name: Replace
parameters.description: True to replace the current selection with the specified object. False to extend the current selection to include any previously selected objects and the specified object. This parameter is used only with sheets.

methods.name: SeriesCollection
methods.description: Returns all the series in the chart.

methods.name: SetElement
methods.description: Sets chart elements on a chart. Read/write MsoChartElementType.

parameters.name: Element
parameters.description: One of the enumeration values that specifies the chart element type.

methods.name: FullSeriesCollection
methods.description: Returns the collection of all the series in the specified chart, or the specified series.

methods.name: ClearToMatchColorStyle
methods.description: Clears all colors on the specified chart that don't follow the color style applied to the chart.

methods.name: SetProperty
methods.signature: SetProperty(Id As String, Value As Variant)
